einzeiler: Appearance on Podbean's Storytelling Podcast Week Live on May 24.
kurzfassung: An announcement for a live panel discussion featuring Asian podcasters during Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month. The event highlights various podcasts and the stories and experiences behind them. It takes place live on May 24.
stichpunkte: Participation in Podbean's Storytelling Podcast Week Live on May 24
Part of a panel highlighting Asian American and Pacific Islander podcasters
Discussion topics include individual podcasts and the stories behind the stories
Sharing experiences as podcasters during AAPI Heritage Month
beschreibung: Hi everyone. I want to let you know that on May 24, I will be part of a panel of Asian podcasters on Podbean’s Storytelling Podcast Week Live show. It’s Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month, and this live show will be highlighting AAPI podcasters. We will be discussing our podcasts, the stories behind our stories, and our experiences as podcasters. I’m looking forward to it, and I hope you will tune in as well. The show will be live on May 24 at 3 p.m. eastern time. I have included the registration link with this announcement on my podcasts’ websites, outlawsofthemarsh.com and 3kingdomspodcast.com. See you there!
